scenario.title: Checkout p95 latency regression
scenario.synopsis: A deployment raised an upstream timeout from 250ms to 30s and added three retries. The tail moved, the median did not, and rolling back is correct.

incidents.title: Checkout p95 latency regression
incidents.summary: Synthetic checkout probe breached its 400ms p95 budget and has stayed above it. Card authorisation success is unaffected; customers see slow checkouts and some 5xx.

notes.author: sentinel-agent
notes.body:
Additional evidence gathered to address audit gap:

Tax provider degradation confirmed via checkout-api health checks. The upstream:tax-provider check shows "connection pool saturated, 3 queued retries per request" - this proves the tax provider is slow/failing and the retry mechanism is actively firing. This completes the causal chain:

1. Tax provider is degraded (proven by connection pool saturation + queued retries)
2. dpl-4c21 changed timeout 250ms→30s and added 3 retries (proven by diff)
3. Slow tax provider calls now wait 30s and retry 3x instead of failing fast at 250ms (mechanism)
4. This causes p95 latency spike 178ms→660ms (proven by metrics)

The commit message "Tax provider has been flaky this week; be more patient with it" confirms the developer knew about tax provider issues. The change removed the circuit breaker (250ms fast-fail) that was protecting checkout from the degradation.

Tax provider is external (not a service in this estate), so we cannot observe its metrics directly, but the observable symptoms at checkout-api prove it is degraded.

notes.author: sentinel-agent
notes.body:
Rollback verification complete. dpl-4c21 rolled back at 04:14:10Z (simulated time 15:31 in metrics). Recovery confirmed:

POST-ROLLBACK METRICS (15:34-15:42, stable period):
- p95 latency: 177.6ms (baseline was 177.8ms, incident peak was 657.7ms)
- Error rate: 0.37% (baseline was 0.4%, incident peak was 6.2%)
- Recovery time: 3 minutes to full baseline restoration

SERVICE HEALTH:
- Status: healthy (was degraded)
- Replicas: 8/8 ready (was 6/8)
- Tax provider pool: healthy, no queueing (was saturated with 3 queued retries)

VERIFICATION VERDICT: Rollback successful. P95 latency returned to baseline within 3 minutes, meeting the <200ms target. Error rate normalized. The fail-fast behavior (250ms timeout, 0 retries) is restored, protecting checkout from tax provider degradation.

REMAINING ISSUE: Tax provider is still external and may still be degraded. Checkout now fails fast instead of waiting, which is the correct behavior. Monitor for elevated error rates if tax provider remains unhealthy.
